name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval
description: A stack of tool-call cards for an AI agent: each pending call shows the command or fields it wants to run, its reason and Allow or Deny, then folds into a one-line trace as its output streams in.
use: An agent can run shell commands or edit files and each action needs explicit consent.
avoid: Trusted, low-risk automation: asking every call, plus a hold for destructive ones, stalls the flow.
a11y: Every action is keyboard reachable, including press and hold, and controls are labelled; the hold fill ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Rounded dark cards on black. A pending call shows a tinted tool icon, a title, a monospace tool name, a code or two-column field box, a reason line and a footer with a checkbox, Deny and a white Allow pill; destructive calls swap the pill for a red Hold to allow button and a red Destructive tag.
behaves: The current call is expanded while earlier ones fold into compact trace lines with a status mark and command. Allowing or denying advances to the next call, holding the red button fills it for about a second before it confirms, and a running call streams output lines that later expand on click.
customise: The calls array and an onRespond callback are props; tool icons, tints and the hold duration are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few cards and trace lines; motion runs only on a decision or a streamed output line.

props.name: onRespond
props.type: (id: string, approved: boolean, always: boolean) => void
